links.title: Your link library
links.body: Every short link in this workspace, newest first, 25 to a page. Archived and deleted links have their own tabs, and deleted ones can be restored for 30 days.

filters.title: Find links and act in bulk
filters.body: Search by key, destination or title, then use Filter to narrow by tag, status, domain, campaign or date. Tick links across pages and filters to archive, tag, move to a campaign or delete up to 500 at once.

newLink.title: Create a link
newLink.body: Open the full form here, or paste a URL anywhere on this page to start one. The new short link is copied for you.

customKey.title: Choose the key
customKey.body: Pick the part after the slash, like shortn.at/spring-sale. If you rename it later, the old key keeps redirecting.

password.title: Protect a link
password.body: Ask visitors for a password before they're redirected, with an optional hint on the password page.

rules.title: Rules, expiry and app links
rules.body: Schedule when a link works, cap its visits, route visitors by country or device, split traffic between destinations, open apps directly and set the social preview.

linkPages.title: Everything about one link
linkPages.body: Each link has its own pages: overview, analytics, QR code, UTM variants and edit. The overview also shows destination health from weekly checks.

qr.title: QR codes
qr.body: Every code has its own short link, so you can change where it goes after printing. Scans are counted separately from clicks.

qrDesign.title: Design for print
qrDesign.body: Set colours, shapes, a frame and a caption while a live check confirms the code still scans. Export SVG, PNG or PDF at the size you need from the code's page.

qrLogo.title: Add your logo
qrLogo.body: Place your logo in the centre of the code. Error correction goes up so it stays readable.

bio.title: Bio pages
bio.body: Each page lives at its own handle.shortn.at address. Add sections, pick a theme and drag sections into order; edits stay in a draft until you publish.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: Clicks and scans across the workspace, compared with the previous period. Every filter lives in the address, so you can bookmark or share a view.

breakdowns.title: Breakdowns and exports
breakdowns.body: See where visits come from by country, referrer, device and UTM tag, filter by any row, and export the raw events as CSV.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.body: Group links under a campaign, build UTM-tagged links for each channel and read their results together.

imports.title: Imports and exports
imports.body: Bring in links or QR codes from a CSV file or a pasted list, with a dry run before anything is created. Link, analytics and workspace exports also run in the background.

domains.title: Custom domains
domains.body: Use your own domain for links or a bio page. Each domain needs its own custom-domain add-on.

members.title: Members and roles
members.body: Invite people as admins, members or viewers. Pending invites count towards your seats.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.body: Connect your own systems to the REST API with keys scoped to what they need. AI assistants can connect through the MCP server.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.body: Receive an event at your endpoint when links and other resources change, with delivery history and redelivery.

security.title: Security
security.body: Turn on two-factor authentication here and add passkeys under Sign-in methods. Enterprise workspaces can also set up workplace SSO.

billing.title: Billing
billing.body: Your plan, usage and invoices. Upgrades apply right away and are prorated; downgrades take effect at the end of the period.

finish.title: That's the tour
finish.body: You can take it again, or see what's new, from the help menu at any time.
